thread: mira: Quick design sync — uploaded a mock for an 'Approval Overview' modal (link). Purpose: give reviewers a single-pane summary before bulk approve so they can scan failures, sample outputs, and opt to require reasons. Need feedback on layout, copy, and a11y behavior. sam: skimmed. love the one-pane idea. question: do we show the sample outputs inline or collapsed by default? Showing too many samples could be noisy. olivia: UX opinion: show up to 3 collapsed samples per prompt with a 'show more' expander. Label the expander like "View 2 more examples" not just "More". Also for the require-reason toggle, wording should be clear: "Require rejection reason" (checked = force modal textbox on reject). kevin: implementation notes: modal should trap focus and set aria-modal="true". If we expose a keyboard shortcut to open the modal (?), ensure it doesn't conflict with other keys. Also sample outputs should be in an aria-live="polite" region when expanded. a11y-bot: Automated picks: ensure contrast for modal backdrop, focus order starts at modal heading, and close button has aria-label="Close approval overview". Flag: sample code blocks need role="group" with aria-labelledby referencing prompt label. mira: good catches. For copy, options: 1) "Review summary: 12 items" 2) "Approve 12 items" 3) header + subtext: "Choose whether to approve these items in bulk. Review samples to check for regressions." Which reads best? olivia: prefer header + subtext for clarity. Header could be short: "Approval summary (12)" and subtext as you outlined. Keep primary CTA as "Approve" and secondary as "Review individually" or "Cancel"? We probably need 'Review individually' to let people jump into the list. sam: for clarity I'd prefer 'Review individually' as secondary. Also add a subtle checkbox area: "Require reviewer note on reject" with a small help tooltip. ekevi n: typo in prev msg — confirming: when 'Require reviewer note' is checked, any rejected item should prompt a small inline textarea in the diff row, not a full-page modal. That keeps context. We'll add a global guard: if user tries to bulk-approve >50 items while the toggle is checked, show confirmation. qa-bot: Test task: modal-focus-trap, sample-expand-aria, require-reason-enforced. Scheduling. a11y-bot: Suggestion: avoid using only color to indicate sample pass/fail. Add icons and text: 'Mismatch' / 'OK'. Use visually hidden text for screen readers (e.g., Mismatch). olm: small microcopy tweak: change 'Review samples to check for regressions' -> 'Scan samples for regressions and quality issues' (stronger). mira: action items: 1) Modal traps focus, aria-modal true, close btn labelled 2) Show up to 3 collapsed samples with "View X more examples" 3) Header + subtext copy variant (mira to post final copy) 4) Primary CTA: Approve; secondary: Review individually 5) Require-reason toggle with help tooltip and enforcement inline 6) Avoid color-only pass/fail markers; add icons + sr-only text. kevin: I'll sketch the a11y attributes and add unit tests for focus trap + aria-live on expansion. ETA: tomorrow AM. olivia: I'll prepare the final microcopy and run a 2-option poll: header+subtext vs. single-line header. mira: thanks all. linking updated Figma + QA tasks once done. :sparkles:
